summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every provider call failed and orders were marked processed without payment.
recommended: Fix Decimal serialization in the v1.6 payments client and add a test before redeploying

events.text:
version: v1.6
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
The v1.6 deploy broke payments, and the failures are still happening. I'll roll it back first.
Rolled back version v1.6 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every provider call failed and orders were marked processed without payment.
evidence: payment DEBUG: provider call failed: Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable (19x)
recent_changes: v1.6 payments client: upgrade HTTP library, 0 min ago

args.impact: Alert showed 10 of 27 orders processed without payment (unpaid total_sar 4781.93). Reprocessing paid 27 orders, money_recovered total_sar 11938.94 (SAR 5806.15, USD 1635.41). No ledger integrity failures.
recommended_actions: Fix Decimal serialization in the v1.6 payments client and add a test before redeploying

args.summary: The v1.6 deploy broke payment calls with a Decimal JSON serialization error. Orders were marked processed with no payment while /health stayed green. I rolled back to v1.3 and reprocessed the unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
